title: 媒体与广告：日常信息、推荐与消费选择
intro: 从课程广告、购物视频、小店推荐和新闻标题出发，读懂四种日常经历，积累描述信息、兴趣和选择的常用表达。
lesson_md:
### 媒体、广告和我们的日常选择

早上看到一条新闻推送，午休刷到一段产品视频，周末听朋友推荐一家店：这些信息进入生活的方式不同。**Media** 可以指报纸、广播、网站等传播信息的渠道；**advertising** 是广告宣传这类活动；一则具体广告可以叫 **an advertisement** 或 **an ad**。下面从四个熟悉的场景积累表达。

### 先认识这个话题里的几件事

- **信息渠道｜media channels**：报纸和广播、视频网站和社交平台都可以传递信息。同一家店可以在街边贴海报，也可以在手机里发短视频。描述渠道时，常说 **on social media**、**on the radio**、**in a newspaper**。例：I usually hear about local events on social media.（我通常在社交媒体上得知本地活动。）
- **受众和需要｜audience and needs**：受众就是一条信息想接触的人。面向上班族的课程广告可能突出晚间时间；面向初学者的广告可能突出从基础教起。**be aimed at** 表示“面向”：The course is aimed at complete beginners.（这门课面向零基础学习者。）
- **吸引注意和介绍产品｜attention and product details**：图片、音乐和广告语使人停下来看；价格、尺寸、时间和使用方式则介绍具体产品。同一段内容可以同时做这两件事。**catch someone's eye** 表示“引起某人的注意”：The colourful poster caught my eye.（那张色彩鲜明的海报吸引了我。）
- **宣传、推荐和使用体验｜promotion, recommendations and experience**：商家宣传产品，朋友根据经历推荐，使用者写下用过以后的感受。谈自己的选择时，可以具体说是谁提到它、提到了什么，再讲自己实际使用后的印象。**live up to expectations** 表示“达到预期”：The cafe lived up to my expectations.（这家咖啡馆达到了我的预期。）
- **日常媒体习惯｜media habits**：什么时候看、喜欢什么内容、会不会收藏或转发，都是这个话题的一部分。**turn off notifications** 是关闭通知，**save a post for later** 是收藏帖子以后再看。例：I save longer articles for the weekend.（我把较长的文章留到周末看。）

### 情境一｜想报一门课，广告里哪些话吸引了我？

On her way home, Maya sees an advertisement for an evening language course. A bright photograph and a catchy slogan catch her attention. She has wanted to speak more confidently at work, so she saves the page instead of signing up immediately. At home, she looks through the course description. The lessons are twice a week, and each group has eight students.

The advertised price seems reasonable, but the textbook costs extra. Maya also wants to know whether the teacher gives individual feedback. She sends a short message asking about the total cost and a trial lesson. The advertisement has helped her discover a course; the extra details will help her decide whether it fits her routine.

**读懂这个场景**：Maya 因为工作中需要更自信地交流，对广告产生了兴趣。她先保存页面，再查看上课频率、人数、教材费和反馈安排。这段经历可以按“看到什么 → 为什么注意到 → 又做了什么”来讲，细节比反复说 useful 更具体。**A trial lesson** 是体验课；**costs extra** 表示需要另外付钱。

**两句值得带走**

- **She saves the page instead of signing up immediately.** 她先保存页面，没有马上报名。**instead of + 名词／动词 -ing**：I read a sample chapter instead of buying the book straight away.（我先看了试读章节，没有立即买书。）
- **She wants to know whether the teacher gives individual feedback.** 她想知道老师是否提供个人反馈。**want to know whether + 陈述语序**，可换成 I want to know whether the fee includes the materials.（我想知道费用是否包含学习材料。）

### 情境二｜刷到喜欢的东西：从被吸引到实际购买

Leo often scrolls through cooking videos while waiting for the bus. One evening, a creator demonstrates a compact coffee maker in a small kitchen. The video is labelled as a sponsored post, but Leo still finds the demonstration useful because it shows how much space the machine takes up. He likes the design and adds it to his online basket.

Before paying, he measures the counter in his own kitchen and reads comments about cleaning the machine. He realises that he would use it only at weekends, since he usually drinks coffee at the office. He leaves it in the basket for a day. When he returns, he decides to keep using the simple coffee pot he already owns.

**读懂这个场景**：Leo 被实际演示吸引，也确实觉得机器好看，但随后考虑了厨房大小、清洗和使用频率。**Add it to his basket** 是加入购物车；**leave it in the basket** 是先放着。这段话也能用来描述“很心动，最后没有买”的经历。**Only at weekends** 让“用得不多”变得具体。

**两句值得带走**

- **It shows how much space the machine takes up.** 视频展示了机器占多大空间。**take up space／time** 表示占用空间／时间：The app takes up too much space on my phone.（这个应用占了太多手机空间。）
- **He decides to keep using the simple coffee pot he already owns.** 他决定继续使用已有的咖啡壶。**keep doing** 表示继续做；**the ... he already owns** 可以放进消费话题：I repaired the bag I already owned.（我修好了自己原来那个包。）

### 情境三｜一张海报和朋友的一句话

A small bakery opens near Sara's office. Its owner puts a simple poster in the window with a photograph of the lunch menu and the opening hours. Sara walks past it several times without going inside. Then a colleague mentions that the bakery has a quiet corner where they can sit during their lunch break. That detail makes Sara interested.

They visit together the next day. Sara enjoys the warm bread and the relaxed atmosphere, so she tells another colleague about it. Later, she recognises the bakery's logo in a short online video. The poster made the name familiar, but a personal recommendation gave her a specific reason to try the place. She returns because the experience suits her, not just because she remembers the name.

**读懂这个场景**：海报提供菜单和营业时间，同事的推荐补充了 Sara 真正在意的“午休能安静坐一会儿”。**Word of mouth** 就是这样的口口相传。描述一家喜欢的店时，既可以写食物，也可以写 atmosphere（氛围）、service（服务）和位置等具体感受。

**两句值得带走**

- **The poster made the name familiar.** 海报让她对店名有了印象。**make + 宾语 + 形容词**：Clear pictures make the instructions easier to follow.（清楚的图片让说明更容易理解。）
- **A personal recommendation gave her a specific reason to try the place.** 熟人的推荐给了她一个去尝试的具体理由。**give someone a reason to do something**：The outdoor seats gave us a reason to stay a little longer.（室外座位让我们愿意多坐一会儿。）

### 情境四｜标题很惊人，点进去以后呢？

Jun receives a message from a friend with a headline saying that a popular park is closing. He is surprised because he plans to go there on Saturday. Before forwarding the message to his walking group, he opens the article. The first paragraph explains that only one entrance will be closed while a path is being repaired. The rest of the park will stay open.

Jun sends his friends a short summary and a map showing the other entrances. He also checks the date, because the repairs will not begin until the following week. A quick glance at the headline gave him one impression; reading the details changed it. Next time, he plans to open the full article before passing a similar message on.

**读懂这个场景**：Jun 起初以为整个公园要关闭，读完才发现只是一个入口施工，而且还没开始。**Headline** 是标题，**article** 是文章，**summary** 是摘要。这里可以积累一组讲述信息处理动作的词：open、read、check、forward、pass on。中文的“发给别人”可以说 **send it to someone**；“转发原消息”可用 **forward the message**。

**两句值得带走**

- **Only one entrance will be closed while a path is being repaired.** 一条步道维修期间，只关闭一个入口。**while** 在这里表示“在……期间”：I listened to the radio while I was making breakfast.（我做早饭时听了广播。）
- **A quick glance at the headline gave him one impression; reading the details changed it.** 匆匆看标题和读完细节，给他的印象不同。**at a glance** 是一眼看去，**take a closer look** 是仔细看一看：The offer looked attractive at a glance, so I took a closer look.（这个优惠乍看很吸引人，我就仔细看了一下。）

### 常用词与搭配｜把信息说具体

| 词／搭配 | 中文理解 | 可以直接读的例句 |
|---|---|---|
| **advertisement** | 广告；可简称 ad | I saw an advertisement for an evening course. |
| **target audience** | 目标受众 | The magazine helps the shop reach its target audience. |
| **slogan** | 广告语；口号 | The slogan was easy to remember, but it said little about the product. |
| **catchy** | 容易记住的；朗朗上口的 | The advertisement uses a catchy tune that I keep humming. |
| **promote** | 推广；宣传 | The shop uses short videos to promote its new products. |
| **attract attention** | 吸引注意 | The bright poster attracts attention to the new cafe. |
| **scroll through** | 滚动浏览 | I scrolled through my feed while waiting for the bus. |
| **feed** | 信息流；动态列表 | My feed is full of cooking videos this week. |
| **sponsored** | 有赞助的；付费推广的 | She noticed that the video was a sponsored post. |
| **review** | 评论；评价 | The review described how the bag felt after a full day of walking. |
| **recommend** | 推荐 | A friend recommended this podcast to me. |
| **claim** | 声称；声称的内容 | The advertisement claims that the app makes planning easier. |
| **misleading** | 容易使人产生错误理解的 | The headline was misleading because it left out an important detail. |
| **subscription** | 订阅；定期付费服务 | I cancelled my monthly subscription when I stopped using the app. |
| **purchase** | 购买；购买的东西 | I checked the total price before making a purchase. |
| **word of mouth** | 口口相传；口碑传播 | I heard about the small bakery by word of mouth. |

### 几组容易说混的表达

- **advertisement / advertising**：I saw **an advertisement** for a cafe.（看到一则广告。）The cafe spends money on **advertising**.（花钱做广告宣传。）后者表示活动时通常不可数。
- **recommend / suggest**：She **recommended the course to me**.（她向我推荐这门课。）She **suggested taking a trial lesson**.（她建议先上体验课。）不要说 suggested me to take；也可以说 She suggested that I take a trial lesson.
- **information / a piece of information**：information 在这些日常表达里不可数。说 **some useful information** 或 **two useful pieces of information**，不用 two informations。
- **be interested / be interesting**：I **am interested in** the product.（我对产品感兴趣。）The demonstration **is interesting**.（演示很有意思。）前者说人的感受，后者说事物带来的感觉。

### 一小段对话｜解释为什么被广告吸引

**A:** How did you hear about that pottery class?  
你怎么知道那门陶艺课的？

**B:** I saw a short video while scrolling through my feed. It showed beginners making their first cups.  
我刷动态时看到一个短视频，里面是初学者做自己的第一个杯子。

**A:** Did you book it straight away?  
你马上就报名了吗？

**B:** No. I checked the timetable first and asked whether the price included the materials.  
没有。我先看了时间表，又问了费用是否包含材料。

**A:** What made you choose it in the end?  
最后是什么让你选了它？

**B:** A friend had tried it and liked the small classes. That made me feel more comfortable about giving it a go.  
一个朋友上过，觉得小班很好。这让我更放心去试试。

可以把 **pottery class** 换成你熟悉的服务，把 **small classes** 换成真正吸引你的细节，例如 **the flexible timetable**（灵活的时间安排）或 **the chance to make something by hand**（亲手做东西的机会）。
task_prompt: 可以任选一个想一想：① Maya 看完广告后还问了什么？② 为什么同事的一句话让 Sara 想去面包店？③ Jun 读完文章后纠正了哪两个理解？也可以记下一个你曾被广告吸引的具体细节。
feedback_md:
① She asked about the total cost and a trial lesson. 她想知道总费用和体验课安排。② Her colleague mentioned a quiet place to sit during the lunch break. 同事提到了午休时可以安静坐一会儿，这符合她的需要。③ Only one entrance would close, and the work would begin the following week. 关闭的只是一个入口，施工时间也是下一周。

描述自己的经历可以这样起步：**The advertisement caught my attention because it showed how the product worked in a small kitchen.** 广告里演示了产品在小厨房里的实际使用，这个细节吸引了我。
transfer_prompt: 选一件你真正熟悉的东西或服务，用两三句写“在哪里得知它、什么细节吸引你、后来做了什么”。例如：I heard about the cafe by word of mouth. A friend said it had a quiet upstairs room, so we went there after work. 想复习时，先遮住英文，试着用自己的话再说一次。
